ticker_news.title: Spotify Draws Fresh Buying as Profit Outlook Improves
ticker_news.description: Spotify shares surged 14% in premarket trading after beating Q4 earnings expectations with €4.43 EPS versus €2.85 estimate and revenue of €4.53 billion. The company added a record 38 million monthly active users (751 million total) and posted 47% year-over-year operating income growth to €701 million. Q1 2026 guidance exceeded analyst estimates for operating income at €660 million. However, the stock remains down 28.56% year-to-date despite strong fundamentals.
ticker_news.author: Timothy Fries

ticker_news.title: Microsoft's Quality Rank Surges As AI Spend Efficiency Calms Investor Nerves
ticker_news.description: Microsoft's quality score jumped to 90.08, placing it in the top 10% for operational efficiency as it demonstrates superior free cash flow resilience compared to peers in the $700 billion AI infrastructure race. While competitors like Amazon and Alphabet face mounting capital expenditure pressures, Microsoft maintains a projected FCF margin of roughly 22%. However, the stock continues to face technical headwinds with negative momentum indicators despite fundamental strength.
ticker_news.author: Rishabh Mishra

ticker_news.title: How Apple Is Winning the AI Race -- by Staying Out of It
ticker_news.description: Apple has outperformed major AI stocks over the past six months by taking a conservative approach to AI investment. Rather than heavily investing in data center infrastructure like competitors, Apple is partnering with Google to use Gemini AI technology for its Apple Intelligence features. With capex spending of only $12.7 billion compared to Alphabet's planned $175-185 billion for 2026, Apple appears to offer investors a safer position amid growing concerns about the profitability of massive AI infrastructure investments.
ticker_news.author: Ben Gran

ticker_news.title: Fed Governor Stephen Miran Slams Narrative That Americans Bear Tariff Costs— 'Entirely Inappropriate'
ticker_news.description: Federal Reserve Governor Stephen Miran challenged the widely-held belief that American consumers bear the cost of tariffs, suggesting accounting treatment obscures the true burden. He argued that tariffs' economic impact has been 'quite muted,' contradicting recent warnings from Amazon CEO Andy Jassy and economist Paul Krugman's assessment that tariffs increased U.S. inflation by 0.8 percentage points. Fed Chair Jerome Powell previously stated tariffs would cause a 'one-time' price increase expected to peak and decline throughout the year.
ticker_news.author: Namrata Sen

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Dow Futures Pare Gains As Retail Sales Stall And Wage Growth Moderates — Oracle, Credo, Ford In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures rose on Tuesday as investors await delayed economic data including retail sales and employment costs. Major indices showed modest gains with the S&P 500 up 0.18% and Nasdaq 100 up 0.15%. Key movers included Credo Technology jumping 16.89% on strong earnings guidance, Oracle rising 1.47% after launching new AI agents, and Clear Channel Outdoor advancing 6.85% following a $6.2 billion acquisition agreement. Analysts maintain a constructive outlook on the global economy with expectations for continued AI investment and emerging market outperformance.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
